ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 85:15 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels; white intensity dominates the central regions of both lobes, while black intensity is concentrated along the central notch and trailing edge boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigmentation concentrated at the central notch (0.45-0.55 horizontal axis) and along the entire trailing edge; numerous small, discrete, circular black 'rosette' clusters scattered throughout the white fields of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 90-100 degrees; the depth of the depression is clearly defined by black pixel contrast against the waterline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys increases toward the distal tips of both lobes; boundaries are sharply defined by black perimeter pigmentation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature originating from the central notch, transitioning to a linear-concave sweep toward the tapering distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of high-contrast circular ring-shaped pixel clusters (black on white) distributed across the ventral surface, likely representing previous barnacle attachment sites; highest density found in the mid-lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint yellowish-brown linear pixel streaks detected on the interior right lobe near the central notch; no evidence of deep, high-contrast parallel rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Active barnacle clusters visible as dark, textured protrusions along the leading edges and distal tips; irregular serrated losses along the trailing edge consistent with physical wear or minor trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellow/tan biological staining present near the base of the central notch and sporadically along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
